claims.statement: Personal global navigation opens Discussions and switches Created versus Commented to locate authored or participated threads; these views are different filters, not full repository/organization inventory.

Intro says every created/participated discussion is easily accessible, but source supplies no permission-loss, deleted-content, pagination, archival or historical completeness guarantees; do not certify exhaustive recoverable corpus from visible results.

Search-discussion syntax and broader concepts/management are linked separately. This guide provides no saved-search schema, operational search adapter, independent acceptance or authority to mutate found discussions.
